summary: Contracts 1.2.0, additive only (1.1 __all__ fully preserved; 11 exports added). transport: WitnessInit/Pub/Files/Ready/Head/Close (own union, decode_witness_frame, WITNESS_FILES_FDS=2) and SignRefusal{reason} with closed SIGN_REFUSAL_REASONS = signer_refusal() reasons + schema. C6: RunConfig.isolation in {per_agent_uid, degraded} (default degraded, in config_hash), VerifyReport.isolation echo (None only if config unreadable), RunConfig.decisions_from: Hash|None refused with fault=rogue and key_mode=repro; VERIFY_REASONS reexec_invalid -> TAMPER. ks.witness link/server and ks.identity signer use the contract frames (protocol.py keeps only HEADS_FILE; no ad-hoc dicts left); signer answers every refusal, agent template no-ops on SignRefusal; runtime sets isolation before spawn; verify echoes it and logs 'per-agent attribution VOID' when degraded. Schemas regenerated (/schema/1.2.0/, verified in sync with schema_gen), golden doc:run_config re-pinned (only change), README changelog 1.2.0. Tests: tests/contracts/test_contracts_12.py (43), signer refusal unit test updated, e2e isolation echo test. contracts+skeleton 373 passed; full suite 441 passed (incl. state/monitor WIP). Skeleton run --agents 2 --ticks 10 --seed 3 fresh + verify: OK, isolation per_agent_uid echoed. Left for owners: /proc readback abort (B3-10), X6 replay checks (B3-20), reexec_invalid detection (B3-25).
review: [kabir · done] Additive only (1.1 exports and reasons preserved). isolation is in RunConfig and so in config_hash, and VerifyReport echoes it. decisions_from is refused with rogue and with repro. SignRefusal is a frame with no envelope, so it cannot become a record. Witness frames use a separate strict union. Tests green.
